text:
maria: FYI team - seeing elevated 503s on embeddings in eu-west starting ~2026-03-24T02:45Z. Symptoms: gateway pods flapping, read timeouts. Marking as investigating. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1815553333

ryan-sre: Observed rapid restarts on embed-gateway-eu-*; kernel logs show repeated NIC flaps on host rack-12. Kicking off node evacuation and replacing gateway nodes.

ops-bot: Log sample:
```
2026-03-24T02:46:10Z WARN  embed-gateway host=rack-12 pod=embed-gw-eu-3 interface=eth0 changed state to DOWN
2026-03-24T02:46:12Z ERROR embeddings handler.go:312 req=abc123 client=acme downstream=503
2026-03-24T02:47:05Z INFO  scheduler evicting pod embed-gw-eu-3
```

maria: Immediate mitigations applied:
- Evacuated 3/4 affected gateway nodes and launched replacements outside rack-12
- Forced read-replica failover to eu-north for high-priority customers (CS notified)
- Suspended non-critical eu-west deploys for 60m
Observed effect: 5xx rate dropped from ~20% -> ~6% in 10m for most endpoints.

tara-cs: CS update: creating #cs-embeds-eu-gw for customer updates. Reached out to top impacted accounts; offered immediate routing to eu-north and a client-side retry/backoff suggestion.

ryan-sre: Next steps:
1) finish drain of remaining rack-12 hosts (ETA 20m)
2) validate network switch firmware and bring up replacement NICs
3) if instability continues, we'll cut over all embeddings traffic to eu-north for safety

deploy-bot: Note: all non-critical deploys to eu-west suspended for 60m.

status-bot: Severity set to Sev2. Incident bridge: https://call.redwood.ai/bridge/1815553333 (ops on bridge).

maria: Please claim postmortem in #postmortems; I'll lead. Will post another update after host drains complete or sooner if regression.

ryan-sre: Monitoring dashboards: dashboards.network.eu-west and dashboards.embed-gateway. Alert threshold: gateway_restarts > 5/min.

tara-cs: I'll assemble customer-facing blurb once we confirm stabilization.

maria: Thanks — continuing to monitor.
